Method of Attack: Malicious version of legitimate app acting as spyware in background
Requests excessive permissions (contacts, SMS, call logs, IMEI, email and app accounts)
Collects data, encrypts with AES-CBC, uploads to hardcoded IP address
Attack Vector: Fake website redalerts[.]me distributing malicious APK
Indicators of Compromise: Hardcoded IP address for data upload
APK file downloaded directly from fake site
